a.lede: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.
a.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 disappears from Micro Center amid rumors of a production halt

b.lede: Brazilian electronics and IT distributor Oderço claims that two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 GPUs have arrived at the airport but has since completely disappeared.
b.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 goes missing in Brazilian airport
